analysis: Between-group comparison of D14−D0 CDF changes; not within-group tests
method: Mean paired mouse CDF changes within cage; exact group-label permutations of whole cage curves within cohort. Pair statistic: integrated squared equal-cohort mean difference on log10 score. Omnibus: integrated cohort-adjusted group regression sum of squares. Exact integration over every empirical interval, without bins or smoothing. Holm over 3 pairwise comparisons.
limitations: Exploratory after viewing CDFs; assumes cage-label exchangeability within cohort. Equal cage weighting for inference differs from descriptive mouse-weighted curves. No correction across other outcomes or exploratory tests. No threshold-specific localization. Nonsignificance does not establish equivalence.
validation: 42 mice, common exact score grid, all finite; tails have zero difference and contribute zero to integral.
